title: Paloma Business Retention Discount on Early Termination Charges
content:
The early termination charge of a Paloma Business downgrade carries a retention discount, as a percentage, decided by two records of the account:

- the **net payout volume** of the six months before the day the downgrade is scheduled, that is the payout principal debited from the balance less the payout money credited back to it, both counted from the day after the same calendar day six months earlier up to and including that day; and
- the **payouts returned** in the twelve months before that day, counted the same way.

### Discount clause

A net payout volume of 120000.00 USD or more with no returned payout earns a retention discount of 20 percent; a net payout volume of 40000.00 USD or more with exactly one returned payout, or a net payout volume from 40000.00 USD up to 119999.99 USD with no returned payout, earns a retention discount of 10 percent; anything else earns no retention discount.

The retention discount is a percentage of the gross termination charge, the months charged multiplied by the month price. It is added to any other percentage discount on that gross charge into one percentage, and the gross termination charge is reduced once by that combined percentage and rounded half up to the cent.

### Combination matrix

| Net payout volume, six months | No payout returned in twelve months | Exactly one returned | Two or more returned |
|---|---|---|---|
| 120000.00 USD or more | 20 percent | 10 percent | None |
| 40000.00 up to 119999.99 USD | 10 percent | 10 percent | None |
| Below 40000.00 USD | None | None | None |

### Worked net volume (hypothetical)

Payout principal debited in the window: 131000.00 USD; payout money credited back in the window after cancelled payouts: 12500.00 USD. Net payout volume: 118500.00 USD, below 120000.00 USD. With no returned payout in twelve months the retention discount is 10 percent. Had the net payout volume been 120000.00 USD with no returned payout, it would be 20 percent; with exactly one returned payout, 10 percent.
